generations.prompt_sent: subject: A textless cinematic motion graphic that preserves the supplied infographic reference exactly: one stable central cyan-and-teal server hub connected to exactly six stable circular icon nodes; the six existing icons conceptually map to the repository capabilities Messages, Rooms, Teams, Memberships, Webhooks, and ECM, but these names remain metadata only and never appear visually; use only the shapes already present in the supplied reference and create no new symbols, labels, interface panels, walls, controls, letters, words, numbers, captions, pseudo-code, logos, or watermarks; action: Begin on the supplied reference composition, send one cyan pulse into the central hub, illuminate each of the six existing outer icon nodes clockwise one at a time, hold all six active together, then reduce the complete unchanged composition smoothly to fifty-five percent of frame width and hold it against plain navy through the final frame; preserve the exact node count, icon shapes, connector topology, positions, colors, and background throughout, with no morphing, duplication, replacement, additional elements, text generation, or environment transformation; scene: One uninterrupted deep navy canvas with the supplied subtle grid and generous safe margins, containing only the central hub, six connected icon nodes, and restrained data glows; it remains a flat open navy field from first frame to last and never becomes a dashboard, room, tunnel, corridor, wall, door, screen, panel, or labeled diagram; style: Premium enterprise editorial motion design, flat-to-2.5D geometry, deep navy with cyan, teal, blue, and restrained violet, crisp high-contrast icon edges, controlled bloom only during activation, clean textless iconography, no ornamental micro-details, no glyph-like marks, and no spelling risk because no text exists; camera_angle: Centered head-on orthographic view of the supplied symmetrical six-node composition with level horizon and no perspective distortion; camera_movement: Make one restrained forward push of less than ten percent during activation, then one straight slow pullback that stops when the unchanged system occupies fifty-five percent of frame width, followed by a still hold through the end, with no orbit, cut, whip pan, camera roll, corridor reveal, excessive retreat, or spatial discontinuity; sound_effects: Low warm technology ambience, one soft inbound pulse, six delicate activation ticks, and one restrained completion shimmer, with no speech, vocals, loud bass hit, or musical change.

evals.feedback: The final infographic candidate preserves exactly six stable icon nodes, one central hub, coherent connectors, sequential activation, clean cyan-teal-violet color, a controlled pullback, and no generated letters, captions, labels, pseudo-text, watermark, or spelling risk. Decorative circuit traces appear near the frame edges despite the minimal-ornament request, but they remain nonverbal, coherent, and visually supportive rather than distracting, so the scene passes for final compositing with verified vector labels.
